prompt: Convert a total number of minutes into hours and leftover minutes using integer division and remainder. Complete the minutesToHMS method so it returns a two-element array {hours, minutes}.
explanation: Integer division with / throws away the fractional part, so totalMinutes / 60 gives the number of whole hours. The remainder operator % gives what division leaves behind, so totalMinutes % 60 is the leftover minutes. Together the two operators split one quantity into a larger unit plus a remainder, a very common pattern for time, money, and digit problems.
hints: totalMinutes / 60 is integer division: 125 / 60 is 2, not 2.08.
totalMinutes % 60 gives the remainder after removing whole hours: 125 % 60 is 5.
Build the result with new int[]{hours, minutes} and return it.
